page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: page number and running head above the text. Below them a decorative typographic band (ornament, not text). Then a large title heading in italic roman, followed by body text beginning with a large woodcut-style initial P. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Excellentissimo Viro D. Antonio Menjotio, Consiliario & Archiatro Regio, S.
main_text.p: Pupugit animum Celeberrimi Johannis Claudii (Vir Clarissime) quod postremis meis ad Eum literis excidit, nec excidisse poenitet, quasi per linguae, aut potius calami intemperantiam, dixerim quod nunc dictum nolim, optandum esse, ut pericope illa In nomine & authoritate Domini nostri Jesu Christi excommunico omnes idololatras, haereticos &c. eraderetur ex Exegesi paraenetica quae pronunciatur à Sacrorum Antistite

page.notes: The initial P is a large decorative woodcut letter, read as P. The last line "stite" is the catchword-like continuation of "Antistite" split across the line end; it is printed at the right of the final line and is treated as the line's end. Ornamental band above the title is not text. Ink and stain marks ignored.
